text:
Good morning,

I am writing to express my interest in hiring the Regent for our wedding. We require the vehicle on 02/07/2027, from 8am until 5:00 pm, and I would like to confirm that the pick-up and drop-off dates will be Sat 3 Jul 2027. I would like it to be brought to Finca Los Almendros and collected from there afterwards. Additionally, I would prefer the vehicle to be provided with a chauffeur and decorated with ribbons and flowers on the car.

Kind regards,
Rhea Penhallow
+70 232 851 5294
